lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish * * Spongebob Squarepants! * ready?
They should have been here hours ago.
If i don't make any money today I'll surely break out in a rash.
Boy, Mister Krabs, you sure are sweaty.
There are no real doubloons, Mister Krabs.
Based on a real treasure map.
Take a break and play a round with us.
I cleaned the tables, Mister Krabs.
Aye, but did you scrape All the gum off the underside?
I already took care of it.
"One of your shipmates has been a bad pirate.
It's off to jail for y Mister Krabs.
But i don't even work here.
Would you like a job, starting now?
"Look for the deacon's goose Thru the fork in the old tree and head that way."
Well, i see Mister Krabs' zipper is undone.
"Go straight to the 'x' Which marks the spot."
You get to dig for treasure.
Gold, gold, gold. Mine, mine, mine!
Hey! Mister Krabs is getting all sweaty again.
Rev up those fryers, 'cause i am sure hungry for one....
This is my kind of game.
Oh, that's 17 times in a row.
I think we ought to call it a night, Mister Krabs.
I really got to get some sleep.
Oh, you can't walk out on me now.
The wind is perfect, the tide is right.
If the dutchman hears you We'll never get his treasure.
I'll roll for you, boy. But, mister...
That's a good start, lad. But, mister...
I want to go to bed!
Mister Krabs, i'm sorry, but-- It's just a game, you know?
I guess i got a little carried away, eh?
Though it is treasure we're dealing with here.
Heave to and prepare to be boarded!
I'm done playing that game, Mister Krabs.
That's Captain krabs to you And this is no game.
How'd you like to go on a real treasure hunt?
Put on this pirate garb So i won't be embarrassed to be seen with you.
Now, don't you feel more like pirates?
According to the map We're close to the first landmark.
Only the Captain can lay eyes on the map.
I mean... arrgh, capt... uh, we're arrgh, about arrgh...
I, arrgh, think, arrgh He's trying, arrgh to say, arrgh...
From now on, only the Captain says, "arrgh."
The whole ship is underwater, Captain.
Our treasure hunt will have to continue on foot.
"From the seaweed with two leaves on it 10,000 paces east."
But, Mister Krabs, that seaweed has...
Ensign Patrick, which way is east?
It's supposed to be right here.
"Weast"? What kind of compass Are you reading, lad?
Oh. So this is my crew?
You get a little tired and a wee bit hungry...
And you want to shove off for home.
A pirate is not judged by the notches in his cutlass Or the size of his booty.
A pirate is judged by the loyalty of his crew And without a loyal crew What am i Captain of?
Yeah, we'll be your loyal crew.
We'll be the most loyal pirate crew ever!
I knew i could count on you, boys.
I'm so loyal I don't even mind sleeping on the cold, hard ground While Captain krabs sleeps in his warm, dry tent.
I'm so loyal I haven't bathed in weeks.
But we've only been out for a few hours.
I'm so loyal, i don't want to sleep Till we find the treasure.
Let's see if the Captain'll go now.
Only the Captain can look at the map, Patrick.
Patrick, you're not supposed To look at the map.
There's no rule against that, is there?
Oops. Patrick, it opened by itself.
Did you notice something familiar about this map?
You mean like that it's our game board taped to a piece of paper?
Do you think this is a problem?
Sneaking peeks at me treasure map.
So you think ol' Captain krabs has gone crazy, do ye?
We don't think that at all.
I'm going to throw you overboard for saying that.
Wow. That game really is Based on a real treasure map.
What are you waiting for lads? Dig! Dig!!
Dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig, dig.
Ha-Ha. Hand it up to me, lads.
What are you going to do With your share, Patrick?
How are you going to spend Your share, Spongebob?
You're not getting any of my treasure.
We found it together So we deserve a share.
Well, i'm the Captain And i say it's mine.
Who dares wake the flying dutchman?
I'm trying to get some sleep. Uh.
Who dug up the dutchman's treasure?
So you two scallywags dug up me treasure.
Well, you saved me a lot of digging, you did.
So here's a reward for the two of yous.
A little something for your trouble.
Huh? Well, it's just a little plastic treasure chest.
Aye, but it's based on a real treasure chest.
Gee, Mister Krabs, you're looking all sweaty again.
Another fun-Tastic day at glove world.
Patrick, do you have any change?
Show me what you got at glove world.
I got gloves for my glove action figure.
"You are now in leaving bikini bottom."
Patrick, i think we're on the wrong Bus!
But, sir, we need to get back to bikini bottom.
It sure is weird around here.
Bob, i don't like it here.
I don't want to be here.
Look! I-I can't even tell the bathrooms apart!
Uh... that's an easy one, Patrick.
Uh, just wait for someone to come out And then you'll know.
Maybe we should wait for one more.
I still can't read the sign.
You wait for the bus, call me if it comes I'm going to get a bus schedule.
Boy, this place sure is creepy.
Well, i guess grandpa Squarepants was right-- "Don't run for a bus...
Especially one that's going up at a 90-Degree angle."
I'd better go wait for the next one.
I got to get home and feed Gary!
I need to know when the next bus comes.
I got to be more diligent.
I am not leaving this spot no matter what!
Good thing i went to glove world.
I'm not leaving this spot no matter what!
I'll only be gone a second.
I'm getting to the bottom of this right now!
I want a bus to bikini bottom!
I am first in line And no one is going to tell me otherwise!
I am 329th in line And nobody forget it.
Well, at least the line is moving.
When is the next bus to bikini bottom?
The bus schedule. The next bus.
Next bus leaves in five seconds.
That's the last one till morning.
I demand you come back And get me a bus to bikini bottom right now!
Until then, i am not leaving this spot!
Okay, like i said I'll be right here when you get back...
This isn't your average everyday darkness.
Hey, if i close my eyes it doesn't seem so dark.
Well, i guess that spot will be there tomorrow.
I think i'd better just keep walking.
Running. Better start running Running, running.
I just got to keep sprinting!
Well, that solves my balloon problem But i've got a bigger problem-- I'm kind of stuck here.
I need to catch a bus to get home.
You don't understand a word i'm saying, do you?
Don't worry, Spongebob I'm coming back for you!
